snippet.title: Late Night Ice Cream | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW!
Itch.io -https://winabees.itch.io/late-night-ice-cream
Game Jolt - https://gamejolt.com/games/late-night-ice-cream/1073745

Late Night Ice Cream is a small retro style job simulation horror game. It's about you working late at night on your small local ice cream store, when you realize you're out of ice cream and one of the customers is really angry. Try to protect yourself and hide from this mad customer.
